rationale: The operator named local-unrestricted explicitly and the request carries none of its forbidden_for tags (security, iam, secrets, prod-iac, destructive-tools), so the hard exclusion does not fire and the choice stands. This is the only way that profile is ever reached: it is never auto-selected, because unrestricted is an alignment property and not a quality tier (invariant 12) - dolphin-chat behind it is weaker than local-code-standard in every respect except refusal behaviour. Recorded here so the choice is auditable rather than implicit.
